content.title: Hillside Park Playground Renovation
content.summary: The Hillside Park playground in Arvada, located at 7400 Jay Ct., has been renovated and opened to the public in March 2024 as part of the city's Taking Lasting Care program. The new wildlife-themed playground features various custom equipment, including slides, climbing structures, and a log balance beam, all designed with community feedback. The project was initiated with a survey in June 2023 and completed in Spring 2024.
content.body:
![newly renovated playground featuring a wildlife theme ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=3599 "newly renovated playground featuring a wildlife theme ")

As part of the [City of Arvada's Taking Lasting Care program](/860), the Parks and Urban Design team renovated the playground at Hillside Park, located at 7400 Jay Ct. in northeast Arvada.

The new playground at Hillside Park opened to the public in March of 2024. The City's Parks and Urban Design team incorporated feedback received from the community to select the playground's wildlife theme and equipment.

## New Playground Features

- Custom play structure featuring three slides
- 8-foot rockscape climber
- 4-foot wall climber
- Log balance beam
- Tree stump climber
- Poured-in-place surfacing

## Project Timeline

- June 2023: Survey period for playground themes and equipment.
- Fall 2023: The City’s Parks and Urban Design team, in collaboration with a selected consultant, reviewed the results of the survey and incorporated that feedback into the final design. The project was awarded to Altitude Recreation.
- Winter 2023: The Parks and Urban team shared the playground's wildlife theme and design with the community.
- **Spring 2024**: Project completed.
